headline: Methuen School Committee to review AP scores, Redistricting RFP, out-of-state field trip, and staffing requests.
summary: The Methuen School Committee workshop/business session will cover updates on AP scores, NEASC, SEL curriculum, Constellations partnership, facility rental rates, grants, facilities, and finance, plus approval votes on a Redistricting RFP, an out-of-state field trip, and staffing requests.
